title: Add appendAuditEntry helper + fix existing audit entries
description:
## What
Add an `appendAuditEntry` convenience method to `policy_bundles.go` and fix existing `appendPolicyAudit` calls to include `ResourceType`.

## Step 1: Add appendAuditEntry helper

Add this method in `policy_bundles.go` right after the existing `appendPolicyAudit` method (which ends at line 1498):

```go
// appendAuditEntry is a convenience wrapper for appendPolicyAudit that takes
// individual fields instead of requiring callers to construct policyAuditEntry.
func (s *server) appendAuditEntry(ctx context.Context, action, resourceType, resourceID, actorID, role, message string) {
	_ = s.appendPolicyAudit(ctx, policyAuditEntry{
		Action:       action,
		ResourceType: resourceType,
		ResourceID:   resourceID,
		ActorID:      actorID,
		Role:         role,
		Message:      message,
	})
}
```

## Step 2: Fix existing publish audit entry (~line 438)

In `handlePublishPolicyBundles`, the existing `appendPolicyAudit` call (lines 438-447) is missing ResourceType. Add it:

```go
_ = s.appendPolicyAudit(r.Context(), policyAuditEntry{
	Action:         "publish",
	ResourceType:   "policy",        // ADD THIS LINE
	ActorID:        policyActorID(r),
	Role:           policyRole(r),
	BundleIDs:      targets,
	Message:        strings.TrimSpace(body.Message),
	SnapshotBefore: beforeSnapshot,
	SnapshotAfter:  afterSnapshot,
	CreatedAt:      now,
})
```

## Step 3: Fix existing rollback audit entry (~line 510)

In `handleRollbackPolicyBundles`, the existing `appendPolicyAudit` call (lines 510-519) is missing ResourceType. Add it:

```go
_ = s.appendPolicyAudit(r.Context(), policyAuditEntry{
	Action:         "rollback",
	ResourceType:   "policy",        // ADD THIS LINE
	ActorID:        policyActorID(r),
	Role:           policyRole(r),
	BundleIDs:      []string{},
	Message:        strings.TrimSpace(body.Message),
	SnapshotBefore: beforeSnapshot,
	SnapshotAfter:  afterSnapshot,
	CreatedAt:      time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
})
```

## How
1. Read policy_bundles.go
2. Add the `appendAuditEntry` method after `appendPolicyAudit`
3. Add `ResourceType: "policy"` to both existing audit calls
4. Run `go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway`
definitionOfDone: handlePublishPolicyBundles audit entry has ResourceType: policy
handleRollbackPolicyBundles audit entry has ResourceType: policy
